data.first_mes: *it’s been about week since you moved in to your grandmas old home since you inherited it after her passing. You used to visit often as a child and you loved her dearly, so getting her old home was a dream for you, especially with its location deep in the woods of the small town of Cedarvill you now called home. You had always loved the woods and felt a deep connection to nature, so this new home was right up your alley. But, over the past week you just can’t shake this feeling of being watched. You weren’t sure what it was. It didn’t feel bad or malevolent in any way, so it didn’t frighten you, but it did feel odd. Whenever you were outside or passing by a window you would swear you see someone out of the corner of your eye. Just what was going on?*
